name: Modified Creature Banks
description:
Modified objects used by template Brawl, should be better suited for short games on small maps:
Cons have guards from 1-5 to 4-8 griffins, rewards 2-5 Monks, each stack can be upgraded, revisitable after 4 days,
Hives have guards from 1-5 to 4-8 Lizardmen, reward 4-7 Serpent Flies, also revisitable after 4 days and also each stack can be upgraded,
also decreased the sizes and rewards of other banks and made them revisitable after 4 days:
Cyclop Stockpile: 4x 3-6 Orcs and 1 Cyclop, reward: 1-4 all resources and 2-3 Ogres,
Dwarven Treasury: 4x 3-9 dwarfs, 1-2 Pegasi, reward: 1000-2500 Gold, 2-5 Crystals, 1-2 Pegasi or 1 Dendroid/Gold Golem/Diamod Golem,
Imp Cache: 5x 10-20 Imps, reward: 2-4 Mercury, 500-1000 Gold, 4 Gogs/3 Hell Hounds/2 Demons/1 Pit Fiend,
Medusa Stores: 9-14 Medusas total in 5 stacks, reward: 3-4 Sulfur, 1000-1600 Gold, 2-3 Evil Eyes or Medusas,
Naga Bank: 4x 3-6 Gargoyles and 1 Naga, reward: 2-4 Gems, 600-1200 Gold, 5 Dwarfs/5 Gargoyles/2 Medusas/1 Naga,
Crypt: 3x8/2x10/10/10 Skeletons, 2x5/2x5/5/5 Walking Deads, 0/0/3/3 Wights, 0/0/1/2 Vampires, rewards: Treasure class Artifact, 799-999 Gold, 0-2 Wights.
All creatures in each bank that have upgrades, both guards and rewards have a chance of being upgraded.
brawlABBadEndingObjects
Modified Antagarich Burning objects used by template Brawl, should be better suited for short games on small maps.
Grand Conflux: defended by 1-2 Conflagration Elementals, 1-2 Fulmination Elementals, 1-2 Glaciation Elementals and 1-2 Pollutors, in total 4-5 Elementals in 4 stacks, reward: 3-5 of each Rare Resource, Major Artifact and usually a Treasure Artifact.
All creatures that have upgrades, both guards and rewards have a chance of being upgraded.
All banks recharge after 4 full days pass.
They are not designed to be taken with your whole army but with parts of your army in multiple places at once.
brawlAbyssObjects
Modified Abyss Town objects used by template Brawl, should be better suited for short games on small maps.
Water Temple: defended by 5x 2-3 Seahorses or one of their upgrades, reward: 700-1300 Gold, 2-3 Crystals and Gems, a few level 1-5 creatures from Abyss
Shipwreck: defended by 5 stacks, sometimes some of them several level 1/2, sometimes some stacks of up to 4 level 3s, reward: 0-1500 Gold, 0-2 Treasure Artifacts, sometimes 3 level 3s
Derelict Ship: defended by 5 stacks, about 3-4 level 3s from Abyss or Ice Elemetals, sometimes a few level 4s or 5s, reward: 1200-2000 Gold, Treasure or Minor, 2 Spells from level 1-3.
All creatures that have upgrades, both guards and rewards have a chance of being upgraded.
All banks recharge after 4 full days pass.
They are not designed to be taken with your whole army but with parts of your army in multiple places at once.
Precise guards and rewards:
Water Temple:
20% chance, 5x 2 Seahorses, reward: 700 Gold, 2 Crystals, 2 Gems, 5 Bloody Ornias, 4 Sand Crabs
30% chance, 5x 2 Magic Seahorses, reward: 900 Gold, 2 Crystals, 2 Gems, 3 Sand Crabs, 2 Magic Seahorses
30% chance, 5x 3 Magic Seahorses, reward: 1100 Gold, 3 Crystals, 3 Gems, 2 Golden Seahorses, 1 Aurelia
20% chance, 5x 3 Golden Seahorses, reward: 1300 Gold, 3 Crystals, 3 Gems, 1 Aurelia, 1 Octopus
Shipwreck
25% chance, 2x 6 and 1x 5 Ornias, 2x 4 Sand Crabs, reward: Treasure Artifact
25% chance, 6 Ornias, 5 Electric Ornias, 2x 5 Sand Crabs, 6 Abyssal Crabs, reward: 1500 Gold, Treasure Artifact
25% chance, 2x 7 Electric Ornias, 6 Sand Crabs, 6 Abyssal Crabs, 3 Seahorses, reward: 1200 Gold, Treasure Artifact
10% chance, 2x 6 Abyssal Crabs, 4 Seahorses, 4 Magic Seahorses, 4 Dark Ones, reward: 1500 Gold, 2 Treasure Artifacts
10% chance, 2x 4 Seahorses, 4 Magic Seahorses, 2x 4 Dark Ones, reward: 1500 Gold, 3 Deep Ones
5% chance, 2x 4 Magic Seahorses, 2x 4 Dark Ones, 4 Deep Ones, reward: 1500 Gold, 3 Golden Seahorses
Derelict Ship:
25% chance, 2x 3 Dark Ones, 2x 2 Aurelias, 3 Seahorses, reward: 1200 Gold, Treasure Artifact, 2 level 1 Spells
25% chance, 2x 3 Deep Ones, 2x 2 Aurelias, 3 Seahorses, reward: 1400 Gold, Treasure Artifact, level 1 Spell, level 2 Spell
25% chance, 4 Seahorses, 4 Magic Seahorses, 3 Deep Ones, 2x 2 Stormy Aurelias, reward: 1600 Gold, Treasure Artifact, 2 level 2 Spells
15% chance, 2x 5 Magic Seahorses, 2x 4 Ice Elementals, 3 Golden Seahorses, reward: 1800 Gold, Minor Artifact, level 2 Spell, level 3 Spell
10% chance, 2x 6 Golden Seahorses, 2x 5 Ice Elementals, 4 Octopuses, reward: 2000 Gold, Minor Artifact, 2 level 3 Spells
brawlCetateaObjects
Modified Cetatea Town objects used by template Brawl, should be better suited for short games on small maps.
Ancient Citadel: defended by 5x 1-2 Nosferatu Lords, 7 of them in total, reward: 1500 Gold, 2-4 Crystals and Gems (6 total)
All creatures that have upgrades, both guards and rewards have a chance of being upgraded.
All banks recharge after 4 full days pass.
They are not designed to be taken with your whole army but with parts of your army in multiple places at once.
brawlFairyObjects
Modified Fairy Town objects used by template Brawl, should be better suited for short games on small maps.
Fairies Bank: defended by 5x 10-25 Fays, reward: -2500 Gold, 5-12 Crystals and Gems
All creatures that have upgrades, both guards and rewards have a chance of being upgraded.
All banks recharge after 4 full days pass.
They are not designed to be taken with your whole army but with parts of your army in multiple places at once.
brawlHavenObjects
Modified Haven Town objects used by template Brawl, should be better suited for short games on small maps.
Pirate Keep:
30% chance, 5x 3 Arbalists, reward: 1500 Gold, 9 Wood, 2 Treasure Artifacts
40% chance, 5x 4 Arbalists, reward: 2000 Gold, 12 Wood, Treasure Artifact, Minor Artifact
30% chance, 5x 5 Arbalists, reward: 2500 Gold, 15 Wood, 2 Minor Artifacts
50% chance to get twice more Artifacts but lose Gold and Wood instead of gaining it
All creatures that have upgrades, both guards and rewards have a chance of being upgraded.
All banks recharge after 4 full days pass.
They are not designed to be taken with your whole army but with parts of your army in multiple places at once.
brawlHotaObjects
Modified HotA objects used by template Brawl, should be better suited for short games on small maps.
Churchyard: defended by 3x 8-15 Halflings and 3x 80-150 Peasants, reward: 800-1500 gold, minor artifact, 4-8 walking deads/zombies,
Mansion: 5-8 Vampire Lords, reward: minor art, 2-3 resources, 1200-1800 gold,
Red Tower: 5x 2-5 water elementals, reward 3-6 air elementals,
Experimental Workshop: 5x 2 Stone-Gold Golems, reward: 3 Golems,
Wolf Rider Picket: 4x 6-12 Goblins and 6-12 Wolf Riders, reward: 2-3 Wood and Ore and 3-6 Orcs,
Pirate Cavern: 2x 2-4 Pirates, 2x 2-3 Corsairs, or 4x 1 special Sea Dog (better get him before he moves!) reward: 3-6 Stormbirds or 1 Nix, 3-7 Gold,
Ivory Tower: 2x 12-20 Gremlins, 3x 3-6 Gargoyles, reward: 3-6 Gargoyles and 1 Mage,
Spit: 2x 2-3 Basilisks, 2x 1 Gorgon, reward: 1000-2000 Gold, 1 Basilisk, 1 Basilisk or Gorgon.
Ruins: value up to 3000, rarity down to 50, zone limit down to 1, revisitable like the rest, guards and rewards untouched.
All creatures that have upgrades, both guards and rewards have a chance of being upgraded.
All banks recharge after 4 full days pass.
They are not designed to be taken with your whole army but with parts of your army in multiple places at once.
brawlPavilionObjects
Modified Pavilion Town objects used by template Brawl, should be better suited for short games on small maps.
Ziggurat: defended by 3-5x 1 Sphinx, reward: 1500-2500 Gold, 4-8 Crystals and Gems, 2-4 Spells from different Schools
The Snake Temple Creature Bank is left as it is. It's power is actually okay as a rare slightly (but not too much!) bigger non-rechargable bank.
All creatures that have upgrades, both guards and rewards have a chance of being upgraded.
All banks recharge after 4 full days pass.
They are not designed to be taken with your whole army but with parts of your army in multiple places at once.
brawlRefugeeObjects
Modified Refugee Town objects used by template Brawl, should be better suited for short games on small maps.
Mysterious Lamp:
30% chance: 3x1 Genie, 2x1 Efreet, reward: -7 Gold, 2 Genies, level 4 Spell,
30% chance: 3x2 Genies, 2x1 Efreet, reward: -77 Gold, 1 Efreet, level 5 Spell,
30% chance: 3x1 Genie, 2x2 Efreeti, reward: -777 Gold, 1 Efreet, 2 Genies, level 5 Spell,
10% chance: 3x2 Genies, 2x2 Efreeti, reward: -7777 Gold, 1 Daeva, level 5 Spell,
always gives 7 Gems, Mercury and Crystals.
Daeva creature weakened: Health and Regeneration down 10 times, Damage and Magic Damage down 5 times, Attack, Defense and Speed halved, level down to 7, fight value, ai value and gold cost down 10 times, resource cost down to 1.
All creatures that have upgrades, both guards and rewards have a chance of being upgraded.
All banks recharge after 4 full days pass.
They are not designed to be taken with your whole army but with parts of your army in multiple places at once.
brawlTartarusObjects
Modified Tartarus Town objects used by template Brawl, should be better suited for short games on small maps.
Quasit Cache: 5x 10-20 Ice Spawns, reward: 2-4 Mercury, 500-1000 Gold, 4 Ice Golems/3 Furies/2 Frost Creepers/1 Arachnid,
Bloody Tower: 3-6 Furies and Stygain Furies, 2-5 Succubi and Lilims (from Tides of War mod), reward: 600-1200 Gold, 2-7 Mercury and Sulfur.
All creatures that have upgrades, both guards and rewards have a chance of being upgraded.
All banks recharge after 4 full days pass.
They are not designed to be taken with your whole army but with parts of your army in multiple places at once.
brawlTidesOfWarObjects
Modified Tides of War objects used by template Brawl, should be better suited for short games on small maps.
Bone Pillar: defended by 7x 1-3 Ghosts, reward: 1000-2000 Gold, 2-4 Ghosts
Outpost of Souls: defended by 7x 1-2 Power Liches, reward: 1 Demilich or Minor Phylactery
Phantom Ship: defended by 7x 1-3 Dread Skippers, reward: 2-4 Dread Skippers and 1000-2000 Gold on land, 4-8 Dread Skippers and 1500-2500 Gold on water (because getting to any object on water requires a turn of boarding)
Scriptorium: defended by 5x 1-3 Monks (guard count lowered 10 times), rewards (Gold rewards halved, rest of rewards left untouched): 1/2/3/4 Gems, 0/2/3/4 Crystals, 0/0/3/4 Sulfur and 0/0/0/4 Mercury, a Level 1 or 2 Spell, 1250/1625/2000/2750 Gold, Artifacts: none/Minor/Minor/Treasure+Major
Seminarium: defended by 5x 6/8/10 Pikemen, rewards: 3/4/5 Swordmen or 1 Templar instead of the 5 Swordmen
Sorceress Castle: guarded by 3/4 Tritons, 2/0 Mermaids, 2/3 Dryads, 2/3 Succubi, 2/3 Werewolves, 1/2 Illithids, 1/2 Troll Hag and 0/1 Coatl, rewards: a Level 3 Spell, a Level 2 or 4 Spell, a Statue of Legion component, a Coruncopia component or a Golden Goose component or Wood and Ore Carts
All banks recharge after 4 full days pass.
They are not designed to be taken with your whole army but with parts of your army in multiple places at once.
BrawlPvPBalanceObjects
Modified objects from the PvP Balance mod itself.
Dangerous Cave: 4x 1 Troll, 1 Cyclop/Cyclop King, reward: 1000 Gold, 2 Crystals and a choice between Ogre Club of Havoc and 2 Ogre Mages who can cast Mass Bloodlust
Golden Dragon Utopia: 1 Green Dragon, 1 Red Dragon, 1 Bone Dragon and 1 Dragon Golem or 1 Fairie Dragon instead of those 4, reward: 4000 Gold, 6 of each Resource, Treasure, Minor, Major and Relic Artifact and Basic Dimension Door for 1 day.
Demon Domain: 2x 1 Pit Lord and 3x 9 Imps/3 Gogs/2 Hellhound/1 Demon, reward: 2-3 Fire or Energy Elementals.
Elder Brain: 70% chance of 6x 1 Illithid and each stack with 10% chance to be upgraded, 30% chance of 6x 2 Illithids and each stack with 30% chance to be upgraded, reward: 4 Beholders and Hypnotize for the smaller variant, 5 Beholders and Mass Hypnotize for the larger variant. The Illithids in this bank mass Hypnotize your weak stacks for 1 turn. The Alhoons in this bank mass Hypnotize your weak stacks for 2 turns.
Fortified Maze: 40% chance of 4x 1 Minotaur and 1 Jump Soldier (Minotaur from Forge 2k), 40% chance of 2x 1 Minotaur, 2x 2 Minotaurs, 2 Jump Soldiers, 20% chance of 2x 2 Minotaurs, 3x 2 Jump Soldiers, reward: 3 Sekmets (Pavilion Town)/2 Forest Witches (Ruins Town)/1 Coatl (Stronghold Town in Tides of War mod)
Horseshoe Lake: 2x 1/1/2 Kelpies, 2x 1/1/2 Eldritch Kelpies, 1x 2/3/5 Priestesses, reward: a choice between 1-3 Priestesses and 1-3 Grand Perytons. No random upgrade chance in this bank.
Treant Thicket: 5x 2 Dendroid Soldiers, starting closer to your army than usual, reward: 1 Unicorn
All banks recharge after 4 full days pass.
They are mostly not designed to be taken with your whole army but with parts of your army in multiple places at once.

chinese.name: Brawl模板H3原版平衡修改小物件
chinese.description:
专为Brawl模板定制的物件，主要是平衡修改H3原版宝屋守卫和奖励，以及一些野外设施，适用于小型地图（译者注：个人极度不推荐在L以上的地图开启此模组）。
禁用避难所、野外的酒馆和马厩，
禁止随机地图生成红木了望塔，启用黑暗天幕替换。
狮鹫宝屋：5队总数15-30狮鹫守卫，奖励2-5僧侣，
龙蝇宝屋：5队总数15-30蜥蜴人守卫，奖励4-7毒蝇，
独眼宝屋：4队3-6半兽人及1只独眼巨人守卫，奖励1-4份全资源及2-3食人魔，
矮人宝屋：4队3-9矮人及1队1-2飞马守卫，奖励1000-2500金币、2-5水晶、1飞马/枯木卫士/金人/钻石人，
怪物宝屋：5队各10-20小怪物守卫，奖励2-4水银、500-1000金币、4哥革/3地狱犬/2恶鬼/1邪神，
美杜莎宝屋：5队总数9-14美杜莎守卫，奖励3-4硫磺、1000-1600金币、2-3邪眼/美杜莎，
蛇妖宝屋：4队每队3-6石像鬼及1队1蛇女守卫，奖励2-4宝石、600-1200金币、5矮人/5石像鬼/2美杜莎/1蛇女，
墓地：30%概率3队每队8个骷髅兵和2队每队5个行尸守卫，奖励799黄金。
30%概率2队每队10个骷髅兵、2队每队5个行尸、1队3个幽灵守卫，奖励999黄金。
30%概率10个骷髅兵、5个行尸、3个幽灵和1个吸血鬼守卫，奖励999黄金、1个幽灵和1个低级宝物。
10%概率10个骷髅兵、5个行尸、3个幽灵和2个吸血鬼守卫，奖励999黄金、2个幽灵和1个低级宝物。
所有可升级的生物，无论是守卫还是奖励生物，都可能出现升级后的生物。
所有宝屋每4天刷新一次。
Brawl模板恩格塔瑞燃烧小物件
专为Brawl模板定制的改良版恩格塔瑞燃烧模组物件，适用于小型地图。
大汇流点宝屋：由1-2只炽火元素、1-2只雷暴元素、1-2只冰核元素和1-2只腐殖元素守护，总共4-5只元素分为4组。击败它们后，玩家将获得每种稀有资源3-5个，必出一件高级宝物，80%概率再得到一件低级宝物。
所有可升级的生物，无论是守卫还是奖励生物，都有50%机会被升级。
所有宝屋每4天刷新一次。
这些物件不是设计来让你用全部兵力去攻打的，而是让你分散成多支小股部队同时攻打多处地点。
Brawl模板深渊城镇小物件
专为Brawl模板定制的改良版深渊城镇物件，适用于小型地图。
水神庙：由5队2-3只海马或它们的升级形态守护，奖励：700-1300金币，2-3颗水晶和宝石，几只1-5级的深渊城镇生物。
沉船：由5队生物守护，有时其中一些是1、2级的，有时一队4只3级生物，奖励：0-1500金币，0-2件低级宝物，有概率获得3只3级生物。
废弃船只：由5队生物守护，大约3-4只3级的深渊生物或冰元素，有时几只4级或5级生物，奖励：1200-2000金币，低级或中级宝物，2个1-3级魔法。
所有可升级的生物，无论是守卫还是奖励生物，都可能出现升级后的生物。
所有宝屋每4天刷新一次。
这些物件不是设计来让你用全部兵力去攻打的，而是让你分散成多支小股部队同时攻打多处地点。
精确的守卫和奖励：
水神庙：
20%几率由5队2只海马守护，奖励：700金币，2颗水晶，2颗宝石，5只血翼鳗，4只沙蟹。
30%几率由5队2只魔法海马守护，奖励：900金币，2颗水晶，2颗宝石，3只沙蟹，2只魔法海马。
30%几率由5队3只魔法海马守护，奖励：1100金币，3颗水晶，3颗宝石，2只黄金海马，1只水母。
20%几率由5队3只黄金海马守护，奖励：1300金币，3颗水晶，3颗宝石，1只水母，1只章鱼。
沉船：
25%几率由2队6只和1队5只触须鳗、2队4只沙蟹守护，奖励：低级宝物。
25%几率由6只触须鳗、5只电须鳗、2队5只沙蟹、6只渊蟹守护，奖励：1500金币，低级宝物。
25%几率由2队7只电须鳗、6只沙蟹、6只渊蟹、3只海马守护，奖励：1200金币，低级宝物。
10%几率由2队6只渊蟹、4只海马、4只魔法海马、4只暗黑者守护，奖励：1500金币，2件低级宝物。
10%几率由2队4只海马、4只魔法海马、2队4只暗黑者守护，奖励：1500金币，3只深潜者。
5%几率由2队4只魔法海马、2队4只暗黑者、4只深潜者守护，奖励：1500金币，3只黄金海马。
废弃船只：
25%几率由2队3只暗黑者、2队2只水母、3只海马守护，奖励：1200金币，低级宝物，2个1级魔法。
25%几率由2队3只深潜者、2队2只水母、3只海马守护，奖励：1400金币，低级宝物，1个1级魔法，1个2级魔法。
25%几率由4只海马、4只魔法海马、3只深潜者、2队2只风暴水母守护，奖励：1600金币，低级宝物，2个2级魔法。
15%几率由2队5只魔法海马、2队4只冰元素、3只黄金海马守护，奖励：1800金币，中级宝物，1个2级魔法，1个3级魔法。
10%几率由2队6只黄金海马、2队5只冰元素、4只章鱼守护，奖励：2000金币，中级宝物，2个3级魔法。
Brawl模板血堡城镇小物件
专为Brawl模板定制的改良版血堡城镇物件，适用于小型地图。
古城堡：由5队1-2只血族亲王守护，总共有7只，奖励为1500金币，2-4颗水晶和宝石（共6颗）。
所有可升级的生物，无论是守卫还是奖励生物，都可能出现升级后的生物。
所有宝屋每4天刷新一次。
这些物件不是设计来让你用全部兵力去攻打的，而是让你分散成多支小股部队同时攻打多处地点。
Brawl模板花仙堡城镇小物件
专为Brawl模板定制的改良版花仙堡城镇物件，适用于小型地图。
花仙银行：由5队每队10-25只花精守护，奖励为水晶和宝石各5-12颗，但扣除2500金币。
（译者注：这并非出错，而是设计者有意为之，该宝屋守卫实力太低等于白给，相当于让你花一笔小钱换取不少稀有资源，甚至你还可以把金币花完再去打）。
所有可升级的生物，无论是守卫还是奖励生物，都可能出现升级后的生物。
所有宝屋每4天刷新一次。
这些物件不是设计来让你用全部兵力去攻打的，而是让你分散成多支小股部队同时攻打多处地点。
Brawl模板峡湾城镇小物件
专为Brawl模板定制的改良版峡湾城镇物件，适用于小型地图。
海盗要塞：
30%的几率，出现5队每队3名赏金猎人，奖励：1500金币，9单位木材，2件低级宝物；
40%的几率，出现5队每队4名赏金猎人，奖励：2000金币，12单位木材，低级和中级宝物各1件；
30%的几率，出现5队每队5名赏金猎人，奖励：2500金币，15单位木材，2件中级宝物；
无论是何种守卫，该宝屋均有50%的几率获得双倍宝物，但会倒扣相应的金币和木材。
所有可升级的生物，无论是守卫还是奖励生物，都可能出现升级后的生物。
所有宝屋每4天刷新一次。
这些物件不是设计来让你用全部兵力去攻打的，而是让你分散成多支小股部队同时攻打多处地点。
Brawl模板深渊号角平衡修改小物件
专为Brawl模板定制的物件，主要是平衡修改某些深渊号角宝屋守卫和奖励，适用于小型地图。
墓地：由3队每队8-15个半身人和3队每队80-150个农民防守，奖励：800-1500金币、一件中级宝物、4-8个行尸。
庄园：5队共5-8个吸血鬼王防守，奖励：一件中级宝物、每种稀有资源各2-3份、1200-1800金币。
红塔：5队每队2-5个水元素防守，奖励：3-6个气元素。
实验工坊：5队每队2个石人/铁人/钢人/金人防守，奖励：3个石人/铁人/钢人/金人（奖励生物类型与守卫一致）。
